verdict.rationale: Poke has a public API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows a descriptive API docs page (poke-docs-1) and CLI command snippets; nothing shows an interactive reference or runnable 'try it' examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404 (poke-probe-3).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
